{
  "subtype": "exploratory_data_analysis",
  "focus_variable": "state_declined",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "asset_category_type",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Well-separated, interpretable categories of what is being expensed (hardware, cloud, travel, etc.); a strong external axis to segment decline rates against."
    },
    {
      "name": "asset_specificity",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Named-model vs generic-category is an interpretable, well-balanced dimension that plausibly associates with declines and supports meaningful grouping."
    },
    {
      "name": "expense_purpose_signal",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Purpose of expense (routine refresh, maintenance, travel, new-employee) gives clear, comparable segments to cross with decline outcomes."
    },
    {
      "name": "request_justification_clarity",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Clarity of justification is an interpretable ordinal-ish segmentation that plausibly relates to approval/decline and can be grouped on."
    },
    {
      "name": "high_value_indicator",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "A clean binary cost-tier flag; interpretable and a classic dimension to compare decline rates, though it partially derives from the existing amount column."
    },
    {
      "name": "department_procurement_profile",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": false,
      "rationale": "Values are literally department names (customer_support, sales, it, ...), duplicating the existing department column rather than adding an external associational variable."
    },
    {
      "name": "request_automation_indicator",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Automated vs manual request is an interpretable, reasonably balanced binary segment that could plausibly correlate with decline outcomes."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 6,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.72,
  "rationale": "Most added columns are interpretable, well-separated categorical dimensions that open genuine associational axes around declines (asset type, specificity, purpose, justification clarity, value tier, automation), directly enabling exploration of what gets declined and cross-tabbing by segment. One column (department_procurement_profile) merely restates the existing department field and adds no new relationship, and high_value_indicator partly derives from amount. As a set they support discovering interpretable relationships with the focus reasonably well, but the redundancy prevents a top score."
}
